entities.summary: Iris Knobloch is the president of the Cannes Film Festival, the first woman to hold the position. The former head of WarnerMedia France and Germany, Knobloch took over the position in July 2022, succeeding Pierre Lescure, who had been in the position since 2014. She is the daughter of Charlotte Knobloch and granddaughter of Fritz Neuland.
